readings.source_reading: Left margin of the target canvas, about y 2530–2550: '8:D  ←   →'. This is the line end of the fol.140b entry '√d.701(8) Pārasīprakāśa … n.d.:11:8:D'. The → arrowhead ends near x 500, about level with or just below the d.779(1) line, in the gap before 'Pāraskara : Gṛhyasūtra'.
readings.evidence: In the target tile at offset 0,1608, '8:D ←' and a separate '→' appear in the left (facing-page) area. On fol.140b this is a full entry with its own shelfmark, extent and lines. It reads as a separate holding to be inserted. It does not read as a note on d.779(1).

readings.source_reading: fol.140b: 'ff.1-36, Pārthiveśvarapūjāvidhi [interlinear 'acc. to' above a cancelled word, possibly 'from'] Rudrayāmala from Uḍḍāmareśvaramantrasāra[?]; ff.36-9, Śivapārthiveśvarapūjā- / vidhāna.' The line ends with '←—' and a further '—'. On the target canvas it shows as '…pūjā-←—' at about y 3170, level with √d.368(4).
readings.evidence: The arrow height matches the d.368(4) line. The note's 'ff.1-36' does not match that entry's extent of 9. 'ff.36-9' may bear on it, but its relation is unclear.
